components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:34px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--t-fast,150ms),border-color var(--t-fast,150ms),transform var(--t-fast,150ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));font-family:var(--font,"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);background:var(--accent-btn,#c62f1a);color:var(--accent-ink,#fff);border:1px solid var(--accent-btn,#c62f1a)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-btn-hover,#ae2917);border-color:var(--accent-btn-hover,#ae2917)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#fff);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}

narrative.northStar: The next frontier, here on Earth
narrative.overview:
User-approved replacement of the earlier Mission control identity. Omega ClearSpace inspired expansive planetary imagery, confident typography and a scrolling narrative. NASA-inspired blue, red and white connect the narrative pages to the working application.

Home tells the discovery story; Targets provides an editorial destination index. Finder and God's Eye carry the same material and type at a denser scale, with native scientific interactions. Real planetary imagery and API results provide the visual content.
keyCharacteristics: Deep blue surfaces, white typography, red primary actions.
Large image-led compositions and restrained, flat controls.
Evidence graphics tied to datasets and accessible numbers.
A temporary TerraNova mark until the team supplies its identity.
dos: Do preserve offline assets, reduced motion, keyboard access and source attribution.
Do render scientific values from the API; compute science in `src/compute`.
Do preserve data color semantics across views.
Do verify desktop/mobile layouts and run `node scripts/ui_smoke.mjs` after changes.
donts: Don't invent scores, statistics, missing data or a final TerraNova logo.
Don't add CDN runtime dependencies or smooth scrolling over map controls.
Don't restore the discarded Barlow display hierarchy or near-black chrome on individual routes.
